title: Reviewed 23 pull requests on electromagnetism, classical mechanics, space and time, and tensors
summary: Reviewed pull requests to Physlib over a year, mainly on electromagnetism, vector calculus, classical mechanics, space and time, and tensors. The reviews checked definitions against the physics, suggested names and statements closer to Mathlib conventions, proposed simpler proofs and more uniform designs, and guided new contributors through the project's conventions.
